name: Jet Plastics
old_description: Founded in 1948, Jet Plastics is one of the pioneers in the plastics industry.  Emerging from the need for plastics in the developing aerospace industry after the Second World War, we have established a tradition of innovation and service.  As we eagerly move forward, we are confident and determined to maintain our traditions and continue to build on our rich history.
about:
Jet Plastics operates from a facility at 941 North Eastern Avenue in Los Angeles, California, where it was founded in 1948. The company emerged to supply plastic components for the rapidly expanding aerospace sector in the years following World War II, establishing itself as a pioneer in the plastics industry. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom plastic profile extrusion, injection molding, and fabrication, supported by in-house tool making and secondary operations. The company also maintains an online store for stock plastic products, allowing direct purchase of standard profiles and shapes. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

The business traces its roots to aerospace demand and continues to serve that industry, though a broader client list is not provided. The company's history page notes approaching seven decades of continuous service in plastics manufacturing, and the online store extends its reach to customers seeking standard plastic profiles.

Jet Plastics emphasizes a tradition of innovation and service built over more than seven decades, stating that there is very little in plastics manufacturing the team has not encountered. The company invites inquiries for custom extrusion, molding, and fabrication projects.
